Petit FatFs R0.03a by ChaN provides read-only FAT12/16/32 volumes and short
filenames on removable media. `pffconf.h` enables directory traversal and
ASCII case folding. The mount path checks card geometry before computing cluster counts. The host implements sector reads in `drivers/sdmmc`.
[Upstream source archive](https://elm-chan.org/fsw/ff/arc/pff3a.zip)
